messages:
maria_cs: Kicking off compact QBR prep for HelioLabs — they want a tight deck (6 slides) focused on token burn, 90d forecast, and three concrete remediation paths. Deck needs to land EOD Thu. Can @ajay_re pull the latest gen vs embed split and a 90d projection? @sophie_finops please draft cost impact scenarios and a conservative ask. cc @drew_se for fallback infra notes.

ajay_re: On it. Quick 30d snapshot: gen ~1.2M tokens/day, embeds ~0.32M/day. Growth signal ~12%/mo. Rough 90d proj (no mitigation) ~140M tokens. Pasting a tiny snippet below.

ajay_re: ```json
{"30d_avg_gen":1200000,"30d_avg_emb":320000,"proj_90d_total":140000000}
```

sophie_finops: Nice. I'll model 3 scenarios: conservative (-10% growth), baseline (12% mo), and aggressive (+25% spikes from new feature rollout). Also sketch a credits cushion offer (20% reserved buffer) and an opt-in batching/cache recommendation that reduces billable tokens ~20-30%.

drew_se: FYI HelioLabs onboarding: Private VPC starts next week. We should plan a temporary Dedicated fallback for heavy gen batches during cutover to avoid throttles. Also note their ops want model pinned to `redwood-v1-turbo`. I'll draft a one-paragraph note for slide 4.

billing-bot: ALERT: HelioLabs crossed 75% of monthly threshold yesterday (2026-03-20T17:22:13Z). Threshold: 1,200,000,000 tokens/month.

maria_cs: Good catch, billing-bot. Sophie — add an immediate mitigation play (short-term throttle + notified ops) so Sales can avoid surprises at renewal. Ajay — can you export a simple chart (burn to date vs 90d proj) I can drop into slide 2?

ajay_re: Chart export done. Link: https://internal.redwood/graphs/hlb-burn-1769998881 (shared internally). Mini CSV pasted for slide authoring:

ajay_re: "date,gen_tokens,emb_tokens,total"
"2026-02-20,900000,250000,1150000"
"2026-02-21,920000,260000,1180000"
"..."

sophie_finops: Drafting slide 5 (cost-impact math). Quick numbers: with current mix and public pricing, 90d baseline cost ~ $12.6k. With caching + batching (recommended) estimate down to ~$9.2k. Reserved buffer (20%) buys runway and reduces renewal friction. I'll put exact calc in notes.

drew_se: I'll add a 3-step runbook appendix: 1) Detect surge -> 2) Route to Dedicated fallback -> 3) Notify CS+Sales+Infra + auto-apply temporary throttle. Short commands to use below so SRE can paste:```bash
# enable fallback pool
redwood infra route --customer helio --pool dedicated-temp
# apply throttle
redwood rate-limit set --customer helio --limit 200r/s
```

maria_cs: Team plan for slides: 1) Exec summary, 2) Burn + forecast chart, 3) Immediate mitigations (throttle + cache + batching), 4) Technical fallback note, 5) Cost-impact math & ask, 6) Next steps & renewal ask. EOD check-in 4pm PT — I'll assemble deck and do narrative polish.

ajay_re: 4pm PT works for me. I'll attach the high-res chart before then.

sophie_finops: I'll finish cost tables by 3:30pm PT and add the recommended commit wording for Sales (20% buffer + 3mo reserved).

drew_se: No infra blockers. I can be on the 4pm sync for any tech clarifications.

maria_cs: Any blockers now? If not I'll stitch the slides and post a link. Thanks all :rocket:

sophie_finops: none from finance — dropping final numbers now.

maria_cs: deck link posted: https://internal.redwood/decks/helio-qbr-1769998881 (will replace with final link). See you at 4pm PT.
